title: QuiltedCollection — A 10K-Token ERC-721 Backed by Walrus Quilts
summary: Build an ERC-721 whose 10 000 tokens' metadata + images live in two Walrus Quilts — one for each — instead of 10 000 IPFS pins. tokenURI(id) returns a deterministic aggregator URL with no per-token state. Includes an owner-only aggregator-migration knob for sunset resilience.
